Guidance:
Generate a JSON array of objects representing the Requirements Traceability Matrix table. Each object must have the exact keys specified below. Generate at least 5 representative entries.
Rules:
- 'ID': Unique requirement identifier.
- 'Requirement': Condition or capability to be met.
- 'Source': Stakeholder that identified the requirement.
- 'Category': e.g., functional, nonfunctional.
- 'Priority': e.g., Level 1, Level 2.
- 'Business objective': Business objective met by fulfilling the requirement.
- 'Deliverable': Associated deliverable.
- 'Verification': Metric used to measure satisfaction.
- 'Validation': Technique used to validate stakeholder needs.

Generate a JSON array of objects representing the Inter-Requirements Traceability Matrix table. Each object must have the exact keys specified below. Generate at least 3 representative entries.
Rules:
- 'Business Req ID': Unique business requirement identifier.
- 'Business Requirement': Condition to satisfy business needs.
- 'Business Priority': Priority of the business requirement.
- 'Business Source': Stakeholder who identified the business requirement.
- 'Technical Req ID': Unique technical requirement identifier.
- 'Technical Requirement': Technical performance to satisfy a need.
- 'Technical Priority': Priority of the technical requirement.
- 'Technical Source': Stakeholder who identified the technical requirement.
